title: Getting Started with Structured Content
excerpt: Why modeling content as data pays off later.

children.text: Structured content separates what your content is from how it looks, which makes it reusable across every channel you ship to.

title: Designing for Editors, Not Just Developers
excerpt: A good schema is a form of UX design.

children.text: The fields you expose to an editor shape how confidently they can publish. Clear field names and helpful descriptions matter as much as the data model itself.

title: Why We Version Schemas Like Code
excerpt: Treating schema changes as reviewable diffs.

children.text: Schema changes ship through pull requests just like application code, which means teammates can review a content model change before it reaches editors.

title: Remote Teams, Async Culture
excerpt: Notes on building trust without a shared office.

children.text: Clear written updates do more for a distributed team's trust than any single meeting could.
